install.source: mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.local/share"; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3 git; fi; if ! command -v cmseek >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ ! -d "$HOME/.local/share/cmseek/.git" ]; then git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Tuhinshubhra/CMSeeK "$HOME/.local/share/cmseek"; else git -C "$HOME/.local/share/cmseek" pull --ff-only; fi; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'exec python3 "$HOME/.local/share/cmseek/cmseek.py" "$@"' > "$HOME/.local/bin/cmseek"; chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/cmseek"; fi
